youtube_description:
With 17 days to go for the FIFA Under 17 World Cup we are kicking off our coverage on newsclick.in, and our Facebook and YouTube channels. The tournament kicks off on October 6 in New Delhi with Colombia taking on Ghana in the first game. Those two nations will be joined by 22 others, from all six continents, for three weeks of the best junior football on the planet.
